plastic-bottle-material-selection.title: Food-contact evidence: what buyers can actually check
plastic-bottle-material-selection.insight: A bottle is an assembly, not a single resin label. For a US-destination SKU, request the component formulation or material declarations, intended food-contact conditions and the applicable regulatory basis. FDA explains that the status of each food-contact substance matters; its published guidance does not certify any XUYI product.
plastic-bottle-material-selection.next_step: Request separate evidence for the bottle body, cap, straw, flexible seal, colorants and any food-contact decoration. Match each document to the product revision and intended use temperature.

sources.label: US FDA: Determining the Regulatory Status of Components of a Food Contact Material
EU Commission Regulation (EU) 2025/351, amendments to plastic food-contact rules

tritan-vs-pp-petg-pc.title: Why PC and BPA-free cannot simply be assumed together
tritan-vs-pp-petg-pc.insight: A trade name or generic plastic abbreviation does not establish the chemical composition of a finished food-contact article. The EU has a specific BPA regulation updated in 2026. Check the currently applicable provisions and any transitional rules for your article and sale date; this is not evidence that a particular XUYI bottle meets them.
tritan-vs-pp-petg-pc.next_step: Require exact resin grades and finished-article documents before replacing a PC specification with Tritan, PETG or another material. Review the product's components and intended contact conditions.

sources.label: EU Regulation 2024/3190, consolidated text as of 23 February 2026
US FDA: Regulatory status of food-contact material components

bpa-free-plastic-water-bottle-sourcing.title: Check the market and the full assembly, not a BPA-free sticker
bpa-free-plastic-water-bottle-sourcing.insight: The EU's BPA regulation covers several classes of food-contact material, including plastics, and has been amended since its original publication. A BPA-free claim for a finished bottle must be verified against the actual applicable rules and supporting material evidence, not inferred from a photograph or a supplier's unrelated test report.
bpa-free-plastic-water-bottle-sourcing.next_step: For an EU inquiry, request the exact component materials, declaration of compliance and supporting information for the required market and use conditions; confirm the regulatory transition timetable for the product and transaction date.

sources.label: EUR-Lex: Regulation (EU) 2024/3190 on BPA in food-contact materials (current consolidated text)
EUR-Lex: Regulation (EU) 2025/351, plastic food-contact requirements

kids-water-bottle-procurement.title: Children's bottle purchasing needs an end-use and market definition
kids-water-bottle-procurement.insight: A bottle sold for children is not proven suitable merely because it has a colorful design or a straw lid. Where food-contact requirements apply, the regulatory evaluation concerns the actual materials, their components and their intended use. Additional age- and jurisdiction-specific rules may also apply.
kids-water-bottle-procurement.next_step: Include intended user age, market, cap and strap components, cleaning instructions, material list and requested finished-product testing in the RFQ. Ask for SKU-specific reports rather than general factory certificates.

sources.label: US FDA: Determining regulatory status of food-contact components
EUR-Lex: 2025/351 update to EU plastic food-contact rules

water-bottle-quality-control-checklist.title: AQL is a sampling method, not a claim of zero defects
water-bottle-quality-control-checklist.insight: ISO 2859-1:2026 defines acceptance-sampling schemes for inspection by attributes. It helps specify an agreed sample plan; it does not prove that a factory is ISO-certified or that every bottle in a shipment is flawless. Quality acceptance also needs separately defined critical product and functional checks.
water-bottle-quality-control-checklist.next_step: Agree lot definition, severity of defects, inspection level, sample plan, cap/leak test method, carton acceptance and record of deviations before the pre-shipment inspection. Never insert arbitrary AQL thresholds into a quote.

sources.label: ISO 2859-1:2026 — sampling schemes indexed by acceptance quality limit
US FDA: food-contact components and regulatory verification

water-bottle-lid-leakproof-testing.title: Distinguish sampling plans from an actual lid leak test
water-bottle-lid-leakproof-testing.insight: ISO 2859-1 addresses attribute sampling, not a universal leakproof threshold or a prescribed bottle test orientation. The test method must define the SKU, lid assembly, fill level, water temperature, dwell time, orientation and pass/fail condition separately.
water-bottle-lid-leakproof-testing.next_step: Ask the supplier to document the leak-check procedure on a production-representative sample, record the gasket and closure design, and agree the inspection sampling plan for the lot.

sources.label: ISO 2859-1:2026 — acceptance sampling for attributes

tritan-bottle-yellowing-causes-preventio.title: What Eastman's published Tritan data supports
tritan-bottle-yellowing-causes-preventio.insight: Eastman's published Tritan materials describe excellent clarity, chemical resistance, heat resistance and dishwasher durability, and its processing guidance notes that versions of Tritan can use additive packages such as UV. These are material-level references, not proof that a specific XUYI bottle will never discolor under every exposure condition.
tritan-bottle-yellowing-causes-preventio.next_step: Ask the supplier for the exact resin grade, formulation and finished-bottle test conditions. If UV exposure is commercially important, define the exposure method and acceptance criteria instead of treating the Tritan trade name as a lifetime-clarity guarantee.

plastic-water-bottle-food-contact-compli.title: Official references for food-contact documentation
plastic-water-bottle-food-contact-compli.insight: US food-contact status depends on relevant substances and authorized conditions of use; EU plastic food-contact rules have their own documentation requirements. Neither a resin name nor a generic marketing badge establishes that every finished configuration is covered.
plastic-water-bottle-food-contact-compli.next_step: Request evidence tied to the exact bottle, components, intended use and destination market.

custom-water-bottle-mold-cost-lead-time.title: Reference on design rights and ownership
custom-water-bottle-mold-cost-lead-time.insight: Patent and design rights are legal rights that differ from the physical mold itself. Buyers should document the tool's ownership, permitted use, storage and transfer in the supply agreement, and review intellectual-property issues separately.
custom-water-bottle-mold-cost-lead-time.next_step: Put the physical tool terms in the quotation and contract, and seek qualified legal advice for jurisdiction-specific rights.

custom-water-bottle-color-matching-panto.title: Pantone references for plastic color communication
custom-water-bottle-color-matching-panto.insight: Pantone provides plastic chips designed to communicate and evaluate color on plastic products. A reference system helps align expectations, but the actual molded component and its finish still need to be reviewed.
custom-water-bottle-color-matching-panto.next_step: Choose the reference system, identify each component and approve a physical sample before authorizing bulk production.

can-you-put-hot-water-in-plastic-water-b.title: Temperature-related food-contact references
can-you-put-hot-water-in-plastic-water-b.insight: FDA conditions of use depend on temperature and exposure; statements about Tritan as a material do not certify every assembled bottle.
can-you-put-hot-water-in-plastic-water-b.next_step: Obtain exact-model evidence before describing a bottle as suitable for boiling or hot water.

are-plastic-water-bottles-dishwasher-saf.title: Dishwasher material and product-care evidence
are-plastic-water-bottles-dishwasher-saf.insight: A durable resin is not proof that a specific bottle lid, seal or print survives the proposed dishwasher cycle.
are-plastic-water-bottles-dishwasher-saf.next_step: Ask for care restrictions and documented repeated-wash results for the decorated assembly.

sources.label: Eastman Tritan dishwasher FAQs

why-does-reusable-water-bottle-smell-bad.title: Cleaning evidence for odor and damp bottle parts
why-does-reusable-water-bottle-smell-bad.insight: Clinical guidance points to moisture and residue in removable seals and straw assemblies; finished-product odor claims require model-specific tests.
why-does-reusable-water-bottle-smell-bad.next_step: Inspect lid passages and approved cleaning methods; keep material and lot records for recurring complaints.

wholesale-reusable-bottle-retail-assortm.title: Retail SKU identity and food-contact documentation
wholesale-reusable-bottle-retail-assortm.insight: A retail range is easier to maintain when each sellable variant is identified and product claims are tied to documentation for the exact item and market. GS1 guidance addresses product identifiers; the European Commission describes the food-contact framework. Neither source certifies an XUYI SKU.
wholesale-reusable-bottle-retail-assortm.next_step: Have the brand owner confirm GTIN assignment before packaging is printed. Separately request model- and component-specific documents for any food-contact claim that applies to the destination market.

sports-retail-reusable-water-bottle-bulk.title: Product-specific documents and market requirements
sports-retail-reusable-water-bottle-bulk.insight: A buyer's handling check is limited to the sample and method used. Food-contact documentation and use statements must match the material, finished article and destination market.
sports-retail-reusable-water-bottle-bulk.next_step: Ask the supplier for exact-model care and material documents; review current rules for the destination rather than treating a generic certificate or sample check as proof.

wholesale-water-bottle-refill-station-fi.title: Market documents and model references
wholesale-water-bottle-refill-station-fi.insight: A refill demonstration checks physical fit at one site. It does not establish material compliance or validate an untested model. Match documents to the exact components, intended use and destination market.
wholesale-water-bottle-refill-station-fi.next_step: Keep the facility equipment manual beside the bottle measurement sheet, and request material and care evidence for the selected SKU before approving a purchase.
